description: The requests of people outside the company to take part in a public project: who asked, what they wrote, when — those waiting first, then the last twenty decided. Approved, a person files issues and comments in that project and nothing else; they take no seat and see nothing else of the company. Only the project's owner and its administrators see and decide them.

projectKey.description: Key of the public project, e.g. 'LIB'.

name: list_join_requests
